comparisons.peer_topic: Client CPU product launches and performance
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, Intel launched Intel Core Ultra Series 1 (first with integrated NPU for AI workloads) and the power-efficient Intel Core Ultra 200V Series. Additionally, the 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors continued to serve a significant majority of client sales.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclose their 2024 client CPU product launches, specifically highlighting the integration of Neural Processing Units (NPUs) for AI workloads. AMD released the Ryzen AI 300 Series with Zen 5 architecture and its first generation NPU, while Intel launched the Core Ultra Series 1, also noted as its first product with an integrated NPU for AI workloads.

sentences.text: We released AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series processors featuring a NPU for next-generation AI PCs featuring our latest "Zen 5" architecture in 2024.

Our AMD Ryzen 8000 Series mobile processors, built on the "Zen 4" feature our first generation NPU, and AMD Ryzen 6000 and 5000 Series mobile processors, which are powered by both our "Zen 2" and "Zen 3+" core architectures, address mainstream consumer and commercial markets.

▪Client CPUs. In 2024, we ramped sales of the Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 1, our first product with an integrated neural processing unit for efficient processing of AI workload. The Intel Core Ultra Series 1, manufactured on the Intel 4 process, introduced the first AI PCs to the market. We also launched the Intel Core Ultra 200V Series, showcasing power efficiency and long-lasting battery life. The 200V Series, manufactured by an external foundry, leverages our Xe2 GPU architecture, bringing improved efficiency, second-generation ray tracing units and XMX AI acceleration to thin and light notebooks. During 2024, a significant majority of our client sales consisted of our 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors, manufactured on Intel 7, which allow us to serve the breadth of customer and computing needs in the client market.

comparisons.peer_topic: Processor architecture and AI Engine capabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm utilizes System-on-Chip architecture with heterogeneous computing, including Oryon and Kryo CPUs and Adreno GPUs, to enable high-performance, low-power computing. The Qualcomm AI Engine features dedicated hardware and the Hexagon NPU for high-performance on-device AI inference, supported by the AI Stack and AI Hub to simplify developer integration.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Qualcomm describe their mobile processor architectures as integrating specialized engines for AI. AMD's Ryzen mobile processors feature Neural Processing Units (NPUs). Qualcomm's processors utilize System-on-Chip architecture with heterogeneous computing features, explicitly including Neural Processing Units (NPUs) alongside CPUs and GPUs to enable high-performance and low-power computing.

sentences.text: Our AMD Ryzen 8000 Series mobile processors, built on the "Zen 4" feature our first generation NPU, and AMD Ryzen 6000 and 5000 Series mobile processors, which are powered by both our "Zen 2" and "Zen 3+" core architectures, address mainstream consumer and commercial markets.

We have developed System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture with heterogeneous computing features, which uses our central processing unit (CPU) and different types of specialized engines (graphics processing unit (GPU) and neural processing unit (NPU)) to enable high-performance and low-power computing and other optimization techniques.
